ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x > 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

2. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

3. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 16

4. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 2
   D. 49

5. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

7. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 6
   C. 11
   D. 5

8. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 1

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 27
   C. 25
   D. 31

10. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 11

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

12. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 13

13. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

15. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 72

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
